FN-EEXZ92C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 182
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 182 could increase the obligations of: (1) certain courts, by an undetermined
amount, to hear petitions for the re-sentencing of certain inmates sentenced to death; and
(2) the Department of Corrections (DOC), by an estimated minimum of $84.50 per day for each
day the re-sentenced inmate remains in the custody of DOC until their natural death under the
provisions of this bill.
